A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CardioComposer research. All 24 pages in each version, including equations, figures, tables and complete appendices, support reliable comparison. The appendix is renumbered from Section 8 to Section 9.

before.justification: v2 reports original anatomical-generation experiments, baseline comparisons, ablations and biomechanical simulations, including Table 1, Figure 11 and appendix Tables 8, 9 and 11.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental and simulation results in the main text and appendix.

M1.justification: The VAE–diffusion architecture, geometric moment losses, gradient guidance and appendix alternative losses are retained. Section 4.2 corrects the softmax description from near-binary outputs to values between 0 and 1, without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same cardiac, aortic, spinal and knee datasets, synthetic ellipsoid task, and compositional and editing scenarios. Section 5.8 is shortened, but the corresponding anatomical coverage remains documented in the appendix.

E2.justification: Both retain explicit concatenation with adaptive null guidance, implicit concatenation with classifier-free guidance, and cross-attention with classifier-free guidance. The compositional comparison retains the same implicit-conditioning dropout baseline.

E3.justification: Data splits, sample counts, model configurations, guidance sweeps and denoising budgets are unchanged. Section 5.3 newly specifies averaging fidelity errors across substructures; this documents aggregation without establishing a changed evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: The disentanglement, compositionality, dataset-scaling, synthetic-ellipsoid, reconstruction/topology, editing-scale and alternative-moment analyses are retained. Appendix Sections 8.8–8.13 become 9.8–9.13 without substantive analysis changes.

E5.justification: Run/seed disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run confidence intervals or significance tests; the retained references to seed label maps concern input anatomies.

E6.justification: Table 1, appendix Tables 8, 9 and 11, and all result figures retain the same results. For example, zero-constraint FD in Table 1 remains 1622 for Implicit and 34.6 for Ours in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(8), including moment definitions, covariance normalization and the extent/stretch/orientation decomposition, are unchanged. No mathematical derivation, formal assumption, theorem or proof is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims of inference-time geometric control, disentangled attributes and compositional generation across anatomical systems. The new code-release sentence supplies access information rather than a new scientific contribution.

C2.justification: Section 6 removes the proposed remedy of developing localized substructure-selection methods for cross-sectional control. The limitations concerning weight tuning, class-based substructures and topological failures, and the interpretations of experimental results, otherwise remain.

D1.justification: v3 adds a code-release URL in the abstract and explicitly documents substructure averaging in Section 5.3. Figure 12's caption drops the statement that a separate diffusion model is trained for each anatomical dataset. Detailed appendix implementation settings remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 replaces Madani et al. (2019) with Dong et al. (2023) for the coronary-cylinder modeling example. Other reference changes update publication metadata or consolidate duplicate Kong citations; the substantive research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 corrects grammar, citation formatting and explanatory wording, removes repetition, and shortens Section 5.8 and the limitations discussion. It adds acknowledgments and renumbers the appendix while retaining the overall narrative structure.

P2.justification: All 16 figures and 11 tables are retained. v3 changes conference headers and affiliation placement, resizes Table 1, shifts figure/text placement through reflow, and shortens Figure 12's caption. The underlying figure graphics are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new code-location disclosure, explicit fidelity aggregation and corrected softmax explanation modestly improve reproducibility information and clarity. Scientific methods and evidence remain unchanged. Some training and extension detail is trimmed, but the principal limitations remain documented, supporting a limited overall improvement rather than a substantial one.
